prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1379; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. Over the course of ten visits, care consisted of physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. The reported mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injury described. Examination revealed pain with resisted abduction and reduced active range of motion, supporting a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, while neurovascular testing and strength in the remaining muscle groups were within normal limits. The patient has no known prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and function returned toward baseline. Billing records reflect the services rendered, with no duplicate or repeated charges. At discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue the home exercise program as needed.
